Body composition


The more complex 4C model involves neutron activation methods for the measurement of total body nitrogen and total body
calcium, where total body fat ¼ body weight  (total body protein (from total body nitrogen) þ total body water (dilution vol-
ume) þ total body ash (from total body calcium)). A six-compartment model is calculated as follows: fat mass (measured from
total body carbon) ¼ body weight  (total body protein þ total body water þ bone mineral þ soft tissue mineral (from a combi-
nation of total body potassium, total body nitrogen, total body chloride, total body calcium) þ glycogen (total body nitrogen) þ
unmeasured residuals). However, the availability of neutron activation facilities is limited and therefore the latter models are not
